description: Create and edit caller-private self-contained mini apps with data, live sandboxed chat displays, private credential setup and isolated browser captures.

levels.minimal: BUILD POSTURE — Minimal: build exactly and only what the user asked for, in one clean round. Do NOT add unrequested panels, charts, or animations, and do NOT push a menu of extra enhancements after — finish the requested genui, verify it, and stop. Propose more only if the user asks 'what else can you add?'.
levels.rich: BUILD POSTURE — Rich: lean toward a fuller, more interactive result. After shipping and verifying the requested base, proactively propose a short menu (3–5) of concrete, tempting enhancements tailored to THIS genui (drill-downs, live filters, count-ups, hover popovers) and offer to add them in the next round. Bias toward dynamic, clickable genui over static ones — but still ship the requested base first and never bloat a single render.

settings.label: Build style
settings.hint: How much the design agent does beyond the literal request. Minimal = build only what's asked, one round, no upsell; Balanced = today's judgment; Rich = ship the base then propose a menu of interactive enhancements to add next. Rides along as a posture note in the agent's prompt — it nudges behaviour, it is not a hard rule.

migration_note: Native V3 implementation. Current schemas, live policy and configured model/module availability determine callable behavior.
